In 2026 XLV is up 15.9% and XLP up 18.7% while SPY is up 1.9%. The XLV gain comes from big pharma (LLY, JNJ, ABBV, MRK, AMGN, GILD) and a single MRNA event (+177% on 19 Aug, cause not verified). Med devices (BSX -56%, ISRG -30%) and insurers are weak. UNH fell 16.6% and HUM 13.3% in the last 5 days, including 18 Nov (UNH -10.2%, HUM -13.0%). Most of XLP's gain came in two defensive waves (Jan-Feb, Oct-Nov). In the last month XLK fell 18% while XLP was flat to slightly up. So whether the strength lasts depends on the tech selloff continuing. XLV is 16.8% LLY.

Instruments: XLV (0.08%), XBI (0.35%, modified equal weight), IBB (0.44%), IHI (0.37%), IHF, XLP (0.08%). LABU/LABD are 3x and -3x (net expense 0.96 / 1.07). XPH, PJP and XHE trade 2-15 million $ a day, too thin to buy at the close.

Own quick test (about 40 pairs, 3 periods, 5 bp cost):
- The only solid candidate is soybean oil (ZL=F) z-score -> BG and ADM next day. Out of sample (2019+) t 2.26 / 2.12, 2024+ t about 2.05, placebos clean. Positive every year since 2021, but absent before 2018 (regime-dependent).
- ZS=F -> BG also works (OOS t 2.37).
- Cocoa -> HSY, coffee -> SBUX, wheat -> GIS, LLY -> NVO/VKTX and UNH -> other insurers do not work (evidence against the given hypotheses).
- IWM -> XBI runs the opposite way to the hypothesis: after a sharp IWM drop, XBI rebounds the next day (OOS +46 bp, t 1.7).
- Dollar (UUP) -> staples and 10-year yield -> XLP/XLV were strong in 2019-26 but have faded since 2024.
- XLV, XLP, PG and XBI show next-day reversal on their own moves (correlation t -3.5 to -6), but a threshold buy signal earns nothing after costs and the effect weakened after 2024.
- WMT/COST up -> DLTR down the next day (t -3.2; 2024+ -2.1).

Multiple-testing correction was not applied, so results near t 2 are candidates only. The hypothesis file has 21 hypotheses; every oncu/hedef symbol is in the universe. The 5 extra symbols (CURE, RXL, IHE, VHT, ZBH) are not in the universe and were not verified.
